"""Phiếu 231: chỉ sửa module trong mutation-tree riêng, luôn khôi phục bằng finally."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, time

area=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
tree=area/'mutation-tree'
module=tree/'src/view/3d/scenery-layout.ts'
original=(area/'original-source.ts').read_bytes()
digest=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert module.read_bytes()==original
env=os.environ.copy()
env.pop('VITE_PORTAL_URL',None)
env.update(pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run='false',TMPDIR=str(area/'tmpdir'),ART_MAGICK='/opt/homebrew/bin/magick')
mutants=[
 {'id':'road-exclusion-removed','before':'Math.max(Math.abs(x), Math.abs(z)) + r > e || c.road(x, z, r)','after':'Math.max(Math.abs(x), Math.abs(z)) + r > e','purpose':'Bỏ kiểm mặt đường ở allowed(), vẫn giữ lề đường cho cây cao.'},
 {'id':'nearest-variant-forced-first','before':'variants[Math.min(colours[index]!, variants.length - 1)]!','after':'variants[0]!','purpose':'Ép mọi vật cùng type dùng biến thể đầu, phá NN dù vẫn tạo sprite hợp lệ.'},
]
def run(label):
 report=area/(label+'.vitest.json')
 command=['pnpm','exec','vitest','run','tests/td-scenery-layout.test.ts','--reporter=json','--outputFile='+str(report)]
 started=time.monotonic()
 proc=subprocess.run(command,cwd=tree,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=180)
 (area/(label+'.log')).write_text(proc.stdout)
 data=json.loads(report.read_text())
 failures=[{'name':a['fullName'],'status':a['status'],'messages':a.get('failureMessages',[])[:1]} for f in data.get('testResults',[]) for a in f.get('assertionResults',[]) if a['status']=='failed']
 return {'command':command,'exitCode':proc.returncode,'seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'tests':data.get('numTotalTests'),'passed':data.get('numPassedTests'),'failed':data.get('numFailedTests'),'failedAssertions':failures,'sourceSha256':digest(module.read_bytes())}
result={'scope':'Chỉ mutation-tree riêng; không sửa nguồn phiếu 202 hoặc golden','originalSha256':digest(original),'mutations':[]}
try:
 for m in mutants:
  text=original.decode()
  assert text.count(m['before'])==1,m['id']
  module.write_text(text.replace(m['before'],m['after']))
  result['mutations'].append({**m,**run(m['id'])})
  module.write_bytes(original)
finally:
 module.write_bytes(original)
result['restoredSha256']=digest(module.read_bytes())
assert result['restoredSha256']==result['originalSha256']
result['restoredSuite']=run('restored')
result['restoredGreen']=result['restoredSuite']['exitCode']==0 and result['restoredSuite']['failed']==0
(area/'mutation-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'mutations':[{k:m[k] for k in ['id','exitCode','tests','passed','failed']} for m in result['mutations']],'restoredGreen':result['restoredGreen'],'restoredSuite':{k:result['restoredSuite'][k] for k in ['exitCode','tests','passed','failed']},'restoredSha256':result['restoredSha256']},ensure_ascii=False))
